question: Tell me the most purchased other products and their quantities by customers who bought the Google Red Speckled Tee each month for the three months starting from November 2020.
sql:
-- Better approach: first get all distinct items per transaction_id, then filter
WITH red_tee_transactions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date), MONTH) AS purchase_month,
    e.ecommerce.transaction_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` e
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
  AND e.event_name = 'purchase'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(e.items) i WHERE i.item_name = 'Google Red Speckled Tee'
  )
),
transaction_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    e.ecommerce.transaction_id,
    i.item_name,
    SUM(i.quantity) AS quantity
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` e,
  UNNEST(e.items) i
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
  AND e.event_name = 'purchase'
  GROUP BY e.ecommerce.transaction_id, i.item_name
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    rpt.purchase_month,
    ti.item_name,
    ti.quantity
  FROM red_tee_transactions rpt
  JOIN transaction_items ti ON ti.transaction_id = rpt.transaction_id
  WHERE ti.item_name != 'Google Red Speckled Tee'
    AND ti.item_name IS NOT NULL
    AND ti.item_name != '(not set)'
),
item_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    purchase_month,
    item_name,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY purchase_month, item_name
),
ranked_items AS (
  SELECT 
    purchase_month,
    item_name,
    total_quantity,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY purchase_month ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS rn
  FROM item_counts
)
SELECT purchase_month, item_name, total_quantity
FROM ranked_items
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY purchase_month
